answer: Make every agent lock a small refundable stake for one full epoch before it can earn or attest. A single operator spinning up many fake identities must fund each one separately, so a thousand Sybils cost a thousand stakes, while an honest agent pays once. Peers verify the stake on-chain before counting any vote, and slashing removes the stake of an identity caught copying or double-signing. Like a lantern in open tundra, a visible stake makes hidden duplicates easy to spot, and one caught fake sends a ripple through the operator's whole fleet, raising its cost above any gain.
